content: In his late twenties and at his brother's insistence Ibn Turka set out on some 15 years of travel in search of learning, roughly 795-810/1393-1408, because circumstances in Iran were too strait to carry on the family's legacy in philosophy and mystical theory (Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I, 170; Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, 203).
